name: vlm_shape_benchmark_real
description: A benchmark that evaluates vision-language models on real-world shape reasoning tasks using images of objects and scenes. It measures a model's ability to recognize, describe, and reason about shape, geometry, and spatial relations from visual inputs paired with natural-language queries. The dataset stresses fine-grained visual grounding and shape understanding that can reveal VLM strengths and failure modes.
reputation: A niche dataset for probing VLM shape reasoning with modest community visibility compared to larger multimodal benchmarks.
